messages.subject: [Sprint-developer] install.packages() problems.
messages.body_plain:
From support ticket #2762

A new version of R (3.0.0) has been released since SPRINT 1.0.4 was 
released, and now the default versions of some of the packages that 
SPRINT depends on expect R 3.0.0. SPRINT 1.0.4 only works on R versions 
2.9-2.15. This is the error message you might see.

Warning message:
package 'boot' is not available (for R version 2.15.3)

For how to work around this see 
http://r-forge.r-project.org/scm/viewvc.php/branches/release_1.0.4/doc/?root=sprint 


--

messages.subject: [Sprint-developer] Using SPRINT random forest when data are distributed on difference computational nodes
messages.subject_clean: [Sprint-developer] Using SPRINT random forest when data are distributed on difference computational nodes
messages.body_plain:
A SPRINT user asked
=================

"I am using your R package SPRINT. I wonder if it can be used to train a 
random forest when data are distributed on difference 
computationalnodes. Thanks a lot."

A member of the SPRINT team replied
================================

"First of all, thanks for the interest in SPRINT.  Currently, the random 
forest parallelisation is unable to train the forest when data are 
already distributed.

The parallelisation approach is to parallelise across the requested 
number of trees in the forest.  The data should start out on the master 
R process, and will be distributed to all computational nodes.

This implementation choice was made because existing parallel algorithms 
for growing single decision trees are not well suited to the data we 
were initially focussed on (microarrays).  For more details, see 
Mitchell et al. CCPE 2012 (DOI: 10.1002/cpe.2928)."


--
